_comment: Default srt policy for untrusted commands inside the sandbox. Deny-by-default egress: only the domains a personal-OSS workflow needs. enableWeakerNestedSandbox is required inside Docker (no privileged namespaces) and weakens isolation vs host srt — treat this as an egress allowlist plus a secrets fence, not a kernel boundary. Installed to ~/.srt-settings.json by the entrypoint when absent; edit the copy in your home volume to customize.
_source: vendored from github.com/cheshirecode/srt-policy-packs packs/generic-agent.json (sha256 d1424b840fc5953b26d2515a1fe220b5e3e3d884c4386ad4a9040c0be58049dc) + srt-settings.overlay.json, --nested derivation, by tools/sync-srt-policy.sh. Do not hand-edit: edit srt-settings.overlay.json (or the pack upstream) and re-run the script.
